name: GridFresh v0.3
description: Source code, synthetic operating profiles, experiment configurations, recorded decisions and statistical summaries for GridFresh v0.3. The benchmark compares telemetry-refresh policies on a public 33-bus distribution feeder. The follow-up study covers five generator seeds and three spatial-variability settings, with 36,000 matched scenario instances and 648,000 method evaluations. These are simulation results, not utility operating records. All demand and PV profiles are synthetic. The 648,000 evaluations are not independent observations: the 200 seed-day blocks retain paired spatial, capacity and cache variants. The original primary result is retained; follow-up contrasts are exploratory. No experiment was rerun or altered when this bundle was assembled. The package includes reproduction instructions, validation logs and third-party source notices. The numerical feeder data are attributed to Baran and Wu (1989), DOI 10.1109/61.25627, through the public MATPOWER case33bw source; that attribution must accompany redistribution of the feeder CSV files. No MATPOWER, pandapower, SciPy, NumPy, Numba, pandas or matplotlib source distribution is included. Licensing. Source code is licensed under Apache License 2.0. The synthetic data, recorded outputs, statistical summaries and figures are licensed under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.md inside the archive. Contents.
